description:
Goal
Make contract application and declared-domain projection deterministic when one when-bound refers to another type variable.

Signal
Source syntax permits dependent constraints, for example t bounded by u and u bounded by :a | :b. Existing Types::match_arrow iterates ContractArrow.bounds as a HashMap. An RHS-only variable has no direct witness, so iteration order can choose Underconstrained on one run or reject a valid call on another. This is pre-existing and independent of fz-1ah.1, which now closes diagnostic domains deterministically.

Repro
A function declared with parameter t and bounds t: u, u: :a | :b has order-dependent normal call validation. The same source may settle underconstrained or emit a spec violation depending on HashMap iteration order.

Strategy
Give dependent bound evaluation one authoritative, deterministic graph/SCC interpretation shared by Types::match_arrow and FunctionContract input-domain projection. Acyclic dependencies close in dependency order. Cyclic components remain symbolic/conservative unless the type lattice can fold them canonically; never repeatedly unfold recursive structures. Do not sort formatted names as a semantic substitute, use addressed TypeVarId graph identity.

TDD
Pin the source-level dependent-bound call across repeated fresh Worlds; assert one stable result. Cover acyclic chains, RHS-only variables, cyclic structural bounds, and contract-domain diagnostics. Preserve unbounded-variable conservatism.

Acceptance
- Identical source has identical application/diagnostic behavior across fresh Worlds.
- Normal contract matching and exhaustiveness consume the same bound interpretation.
- No infinite type unfolding or HashMap-order dependence.
- Tests, docs, and clippy pass.
title: Make dependent contract bounds deterministic
